conviction_note: 0: the scheduled item is Hot Chili's statutory FY26 annual report (due by 30 Sep). It is not a 5B and not a profit result, and its cash and spend figures were already disclosed in the June-quarter 5B (A$25M cash at 30 Jun, about A$46M pro forma after the US$15M OR Royalties NSR). The only upcoming catalysts the company has named are a La Verde maiden MRE, a revised PFS and the partnering process, and none is dated inside a one-session window. The last two annual reports and the half-year report moved +1.1%, about -4% over two sessions and +1.4%, so nothing here is unpriced.
bar: The bar is the company's own June-quarter 5B: A$25M cash and no debt at 30 June 2026, about A$46M pro forma after the OR Royalties US$15M closed, and quarterly staff plus admin costs of about A$2.4M (https://announcements.asx.com.au/asxpdf/20260730/pdf/0726nyzdjptp0y.pdf, lodged 2026-07-30 09:04). Audited FY26 accounts restate what that document already shows. No sell-side consensus exists (consensus.quarters is empty).
filer_type_check: quarterly_report_only is correct for the 5B cadence: 11 observed 5Bs and no 4D or 4E in three years. But the 2026-09-28 vendor date does not match the 5B calendar, where the next one is due around 30 Oct. It matches the annual-report cycle instead: 'Annual Report to shareholders' plus Appendix 4G plus the Mineral Resource and Ore Reserve Statement, lodged 27 Sep 2024 at 16:32 and 30 Sep 2025 at 17:17, both after the close. So I hunted the annual-report and MROR package against the 5B bar, not cash burn against runway. Runway is not in question at about A$46M pro forma.
event_check: Not confirmed inside the window, but not a phantom either. The ASX 2026 archive (https://www.asx.com.au/asx/v2/statistics/announcements.do?by=asxCode&asxCode=HCH&timeframe=Y&year=2026) has no forward notice. The last item is the 21 Sep 2026 Precious Metals Summit presentation, and the 4 Sep 2026 LR 3.13.1 notice only fixes the AGM for 25 Nov 2026. The annual report is statutorily due by 30 Sep 2026, and prior years landed on 27 Sep 2024 (https://www.asx.com.au/asx/v2/statistics/announcements.do?by=asxCode&asxCode=HCH&timeframe=Y&year=2024) and 30 Sep 2025 (https://www.asx.com.au/asx/v2/statistics/announcements.do?by=asxCode&asxCode=HCH&timeframe=Y&year=2025). Lodgement on 28 Sep after the close, or on 29 Sep before the open, falls in the window. Lodgement late on 29 Sep or on 30 Sep does not. The vendor's 28 Sep cannot be verified in advance, and either way the expected reaction is about 0.
session_check: amc is consistent with history: both prior annual reports were lodged after the 16:00 close (16:32 and 17:17 Sydney), and the FY26 half-year report on 16 Mar 2026 at 19:09. I did not verify the exact 2026 timestamp because it has not been lodged. Sources are the ASX archive URLs above.
positioning_check: The ASIC aggregate short is 0.2725% as of 2026-09-21, down from 0.3053% on 2026-09-14 (-0.033pp, so slight covering), with a 4-session lag. That is a trivial position: no squeeze fuel and no building short to lean against. The tape is -6.73% over 20 days and +5.63% over 5 days, which is copper-tape and drill-news noise (including -7.7% on 15 Sep and +6.4% on 23 Sep with no ASX announcements on those days). Nothing in the hunt argues with the +0.57 priced lean.

outside_window.finding: The company has named a La Verde maiden Mineral Resource Estimate for 2026 as an upcoming catalyst, alongside a restated Costa Fuego PFS integrating La Verde 'in the coming months'. Neither is dated. Hot Chili typically releases an MRE as a standalone announcement, not inside the annual MROR statement, so it is not expected with the annual report.

The asset-level strategic partnering process continues, with several new non-binding, indicative, conditional proposals received in the June quarter and due diligence ongoing including site visits. No timetable is given.

searched_and_found_nothing: ASX HCH archive for 2026, 2025 and 2024: no trading halt, no notice of results date, no substantial-holder change and no capital raise since the Feb 2026 A$40M placement. Only routine Appendix 2A quotations (5 Jun, 18 Jun, 16 Jul, 7 Aug 2026) and Easterday 3Y notices.

Reaction of the annual-report line in the tape: 30 Sep 2025 amc -> 1 Oct 2025 +1.09%; 27 Sep 2024 amc -> the next bar (1 Oct 2024) -4.05%, with the 30 Sep 2024 bar missing; half-year report 16 Mar 2026 amc -> 17 Mar 2026 +1.40%. No sign the market treats the statutory accounts as information.

June-quarter 5B (https://announcements.asx.com.au/asxpdf/20260730/pdf/0726nyzdjptp0y.pdf): no going-concern risk at about A$46M pro forma. One US$2M El Fuego option payment falls due by 30 Sep 2026, which is immaterial.

Investing.com transcript of the Precious Metals Summit Beaver Creek talk, published 2026-09-24 (https://www.investing.com/news/transcripts/hot-chili-at-precious-metals-summit-beaver-creek-2026-la-verde-lifts-outlook-93CH-4916464): no dated catalyst inside the window.

baseline_tension: No tension: I found nothing that agrees with or cuts against the small +0.57 lean or the +5.6% five-day bounce. The event is a statutory filing whose numbers are already public.
